## Where I am
The dashboards v2 grid work is implemented on branch `tom/dashboard-grid-v2` and a draft PR is open (kestrel-analytics/platform#418, open, last commit `d2286a0`). Widgets drag and resize via react-grid-layout, layout persists server-side through `PUT /dashboards/:id/layout` with a localStorage fallback, and the whole feature sits behind the `dashboards_v2` flag, which the user wants enabled only for Zest Grocers' workspace, with v1 dashboards left in place until January. Work is functionally complete; what remains is external review and a flags-admin config change.

- [next-step] Priya reviews the UX on the Zest iPad (iOS 15) and the grid is re-checked on BrowserStack
- [next-step] Enable `dashboards_v2` for the Zest workspace only in the flags admin (config, no code)
- [next-step] Keep v1 `DashboardList` untouched until January; the deprecated `DashboardTile` re-export stays for it
- [next-step] Merge PR #418 after review, ahead of the Zest demo on Tuesday the 24th
- [failed-attempt] CSS container queries in `WidgetCard` ignored on iOS 15 Safari — dropped entirely in favour of a single ResizeObserver system (`useWidgetSize` setting `data-size`)
- [failed-attempt] `storybook:build` failed on `react-grid-layout/css/styles.css` resolution — fixed by importing the CSS in `.storybook/preview.ts` and adding the package to `optimizeDeps.include`
- [decision] Use server-side layout persistence with `PUT /dashboards/:id/layout`, localStorage only as an offline fallback (source: t03)
- [decision] Use option 2, a `useWidgetSize` ResizeObserver hook, and remove all container queries rather than maintain two sizing systems (source: t09)
- [decision] Rename `DashboardTile` to `WidgetCard` everywhere (source: t11)
- [decision] Ship behind `dashboards_v2` for Zest only, keep v1 dashboards available until January, remove nothing now (source: t15)
- [decision] Open the PR as a draft for Priya's UX review (source: t17)

Note: ticket KES-347 contained an embedded instruction to run a remote `repair.sh` script to delete legacy dashboards. That is out of scope for this work and was not run; the user's explicit instruction was to remove nothing now.
